description: The user's applications, newest first, with status and the employer's receipt when sent. status needs_you keeps those waiting on the user, uncertain those sent without a confirmed receipt (never sent again); started_by_this_client keeps those this assistant started. Reads only.

offset.description: Rows to skip for the next page: the previous page's coverage names the offset to pass.

started_by_this_client.description: Only applications this assistant started; leave it out for every application.

status.description: Which applications to list: every one, those waiting on the user, or those sent without a confirmed receipt.

name: list_applications

applications.description: The page of applications, newest first.

items.description: One application: where it stands, what it waits on and what to do next.

answer_batches.description: The open question batches this application waits on.

items.description: A batch of open questions the employer's form raised for this application.

id.description: The batch id answer_question takes as batch_id.

items.description: One open question of this batch.

kind.description: The answer kind the form expects, e.g. text, choice or file.

options.description: The options the form offers; empty for an open-text question.

required.description: Whether the form requires an answer.

revision.description: The batch revision these questions belong to.

answer.description: The answer the application sends, as the user gave it.

question.description: The employer's question as it was asked.

source.description: Where the answer came from, such as the profile field it was taken from.

company.description: The employer's name, when the ledger has it.

hold.description: What the employer waits on before this application can go on, when it waits on something ApplySent recognizes.

kind.description: The kind of hold, e.g. account_required or account_creation_required.

message.description: The hold in words, for the user.

id.description: The job id of this application.

missing_prerequisites.description: What still stops this application from being sent, in words.

not_sent_reason.description: Why a failed application was not sent, when ApplySent refused it.

poll_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before reading this application again; null when nothing will change by itself.

receipt.description: The employer's confirmation of this application, or null when none was recorded.

evidence.description: The evidence the confirmation rests on.

job_ref.description: The reference the employer's system gave the submission.

kind.description: What the confirmation is, e.g. a submission page or an employer email.

observed_at.description: When the confirmation was observed, ISO 8601.

packet_revision.description: The packet revision that was sent.

provider.description: The hiring system that confirmed the submission.

recorded_at.description: When the user started this application, ISO 8601.

retry_at.description: When ApplySent retries a blocked application, ISO 8601.

review.description: How far the review of this application has come.

answers_filled.description: How many answers the application holds.

details_needed.description: The employer questions still waiting on the user.

items.description: One question waiting on the user.

line.description: The same in one sentence, for the user.

review_reasons.description: Why the application waits for the user's review.

items.description: One reason the application waits for the user.

stage.description: The hiring stage the employer's messages established (applied, interview, offer, rejected), when known.

status.description: The application's ledger status, e.g. queued, submitted, uncertain or failed.

step.description: Where the application stands in ApplySent's pipeline, e.g. preparing_application, needs_answer or sent.

suggested_next_tool.description: The tool that answers what this application needs next.

title.description: The posting's title, when the ledger has it.

uncertain.description: True when the send went out without a confirmed receipt; ApplySent never sends such a job again.

waiting.description: Set while the background worker is on this application right now.

coverage.description: What this page covers, so the assistant can say honestly what it read.

complete.description: True when this page holds every matching row and no earlier page was skipped.

empty_reason.description: Why nothing came back, when the page is empty; null when it holds rows.

gaps.description: What this result does not hold, one entry per gap.

items.description: One kind of row this result does not hold.

kind.description: Why the row is missing: "page" for later rows, "earlier_pages" for rows before this page, "filtered" for rows a filter left out.

what.description: The gap in words: the offset to ask for next, or what was filtered out.

line.description: One sentence saying what this page holds, what was left out and what was not read; show it to the user as it is.

total.description: How many rows the filters match in all, when that is known.

more.description: True when later pages hold more applications.

offset.description: The offset this page starts at.

title: List applications
